summary: Milestone 8 brings Direction B Glass Studio frosted-glass chrome to staff WorkspaceLayout, admin Moderation, staff Posts, and the New/Edit composer on Cloudron beta, reusing public Direction C glass tokens.
detailed_changes: Glass WorkspaceLayout shell with teal gradient, frosted rail/chrome, and solid no-blur / reduced-motion fallbacks (v1.5.1 / #167 #145).
Glass Moderation summary, tabs, cards, empty states, plus queue pagination and filter backend (v1.5.2–v1.5.4 / #157–#159 #146).
Glass Posts filters, table, mobile cards, and title/author/channel search (v1.5.5–v1.5.6 / #160–#161 #147).
Two-column Glass Studio composer with sticky publish/SEO/campaign panel and create/update payload parity including expected_updated_at (v1.5.7–v1.5.9 / #162 #164 #165 #148).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff editors; admins (moderation)
Public impact: none (public Direction C unchanged)
Internal impact: Glass Studio staff/admin chrome on beta; no production cutover, Ghost retirement, or live-send authorization
